agentos.description: Install and manage Android applications on AgentOS.
agentos.descriptionZh: 在 AgentOS 上安装和管理 Android 应用。

operations.title: Install AndroidTone runtime
operations.summary: Prepare Binder and install the digest-pinned Waydroid runtime with compatible Ubuntu 24.04 host dependencies.

requirements.depends: python3:any, lxc, python3-gbinder, python3-gi, gir1.2-gtk-3.0, python3-dbus, dbus, polkitd | policykit-1, pipewire-pulse | pulseaudio, iptables

operations.title: Recover Android runtime
operations.summary: Prepare Binder and restart the installed Waydroid container service. No packages are installed.
